name.zh: 165反詐騙諮詢專線（內政部警政署 165全民防騙網）
name.en: 165 anti-fraud hotline (National Police Agency, 165 anti-fraud website)

when.zh: 懷疑是詐騙、想查證來電或訊息、已經匯款或交出帳戶資料時，都可以撥165諮詢或報案。不要撥對方給的號碼，也不要點訊息裡的連結；查證時請自己撥165。
when.en: Call 165 whenever you suspect a scam, want to check a call or message, or have already sent money or given out account details. Don't call a number the other person gave you or tap a link in the message; dial 165 yourself.

when.zh: 正要去匯款、領錢或交出提款卡，車手正要上門取款，或在ATM前被電話指揮時，請馬上打110。真正的警察、檢察官不會在電話或LINE上做筆錄，也不會要你交出存款或提款卡「監管」。
when.en: Call 110 straight away if you are about to transfer money, withdraw cash or hand over a bank card, a collector is coming to your door, or someone on the phone is directing you at an ATM. Real police and prosecutors never take statements by phone or LINE, and never ask you to hand over savings or bank cards for “supervision”.

name.zh: 金融監督管理委員會 1998金融服務專線
name.en: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), 1998 financial services hotline

when.zh: 想確認投資平台、投顧或「金管會人員」是不是真的，或與銀行、證券、保險業者有爭議、需要債務協商諮詢時。金管會不會打電話要你交出金融卡或把錢交給專人保管。
when.en: To check whether an investment platform, adviser or “FSC officer” is genuine, or when you have a dispute with a bank, securities firm or insurer, or need advice on debt negotiation. The FSC never phones to ask you to hand over bank cards or give money to someone for safekeeping.

name.zh: 1950 全國消費者服務專線（行政院消費者保護會）
name.en: 1950 national consumer service hotline (Executive Yuan Consumer Protection Committee)

when.zh: 網購收到劣質品或貨不對辦、商家不退款等消費爭議時，可在上班時間撥1950，轉接所在縣市的消費者服務中心；也可以上行政院消費者保護會網站線上申訴。已經被騙錢請同時打165或110。
when.en: For consumer disputes such as shoddy or wrong goods bought online, or a shop that won't refund, call 1950 in office hours to reach your city or county consumer service centre, or file a complaint online with the Consumer Protection Committee. If you were defrauded, also call 165 or 110.

name.zh: 衛生福利部中央健康保險署 健保諮詢服務專線

when.zh: 接到「健保卡被盜用」「健保卡異常要停卡」「欠費要鎖卡」等電話、簡訊或LINE時，可打健保署專線查證。健保署的催繳和退費都用正式公文寄送，不會用電話語音、簡訊或LINE要你匯款、回電或點連結。
when.en: If you get a call, text or LINE message saying your NHI card has been misused, will be suspended or locked for unpaid premiums, call the NHIA helpline to check. The NHIA sends payment reminders and refunds only by official letter, never by recorded call, text or LINE asking you to pay, call back or tap a link.

name.zh: 往來銀行或發卡銀行（止付帳戶、停用信用卡）
name.en: Your bank or card issuer (freeze the account or block the card)

when.zh: 已經匯款、輸入信用卡號或簡訊驗證碼、交出網銀帳號密碼或提款卡時，請立刻聯絡銀行止付或停卡，並向165或警察報案。請用卡片背面的電話或銀行官方App，不要用簡訊、LINE或對方提供的號碼。
when.en: If you sent money, typed in a card number or one-time code, or gave away your online-banking login or bank card, contact your bank at once to freeze the account or block the card, and report it to 165 or the police. Use the number on the back of your card or the bank's official app, never one from a text, LINE or the caller.

label.zh: 卡片背面的電話，或銀行官方App
label.en: The number on the back of your card, or your bank's official app
